item.title: Vancouver mayor faces questions for first time since being linked to false accusations about councillor
item.description: Vancouver Mayor Ken Sim insists he has apologized after it was revealed Thursday that he was the source of a false allegation against Coun. Sean Orr.

item.title: Vancouver-based influencer charged with human trafficking: RCMP
item.description: A Vancouver-based social media influencer is facing six charges following an investigation into a man suspected of involvement in human trafficking.

item.title: Westbound lanes reopened on HWY 91 in Richmond
item.description: All westbound lanes of Highway 91 have reopened after having been blocked just past the Highway 91A split in Richmond.

item.title: Pedestrian killed by train in Maple Ridge, RCMP says
item.description: A man has been struck and killed by a train near River Road in Maple Ridge, the RCMP says.

item.title: 3 men charged in B.C. extortion investigation, police say
item.description: Three men are facing charges after an investigation by the BC Provincial Extortion Task Force, the RCMP says.

item.title: Man charged after allegedly assaulting a father, Vancouver police say
